subject: Protovis: A JavaScript take on grammar of graphics

messages.author: 9a5ecf22195d9eb0
messages.subject: Protovis: A JavaScript take on grammar of graphics
parts:
Hi all,

Sorry for the tangentially related post, but I thought the members on
this mailing list might be interested in learning about the Protovis
project[1]. It's a javascript visualization library that is inspired
by Wilkinson's Grammar of Graphics.

It just popped up on my RSS feed from dataspora. You can find about
more information about it from there[2], in addition to its home on
the net[1].

-steve

[1] Protovis: http://vis.stanford.edu/protovis/
[2] DataSpora entry: http://dataspora.com/blog/dataviz-sf-salon-no/

Yes, this is a neat package, and this summer I'm going to be using it

the housing crisis.

Hadley
